The Toolbox is the suite's set of circuit elements and the tools that place,
wire, export and animate them. A concept is defined once and rendered
everywhere (VISION.md section 1), and every circuit the suite shows comes
from the Toolbox: figures, animations, slides and, later, web tools.

## Purpose

- One approved symbol per circuit element, drawn to one reference style.
- Circuits as short scripts: place elements, wire their pins, export.
- The same look in every medium, from one style file with swappable themes.

## Which modules it uses

The core model (VISION.md section 4): the circuit schema and the symbol pack,
both Phase 0 work. Browser tools will draw with the symbol pack, so web
output matches the LaTeX and animation output exactly.

## Status

The element library and its Python tools exist; their documentation lives in
the repository that holds them. The public, browser-based Toolbox, with one
standalone web tool per job, doesn't exist yet. This page will link to it
when it does.

## Where to start

Read VISION.md sections 1 and 4. When the first web tool is published, it
will be linked here.
